=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:195-201 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `if [ "${delivered}" -gt 0 ]` gate in `stage_switch_report` writes the day marker and `alerted=true` when any alert is delivered, even if other alerts in the same run fail. The workflow step "Record today's stage switch alert" (.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:467-473) then saves `stage-switch-off-alert-<day>`.
  WHY: Later runs that day get `cache-hit == 'true'` and log `alert=already_sent_today`, so the failed alerts wait until the next 06:00 UTC run, which breaks the retry promise in the script header (lines 17-20) and the README "Alert" bullet. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (fix the wording; gating on `delivered -eq attempted` would resend alerts that were already delivered), while minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR. The highest rating (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:180-184 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The day-marker file and the `alerted=true` output are written even if only some of the alerts are delivered.
  WHY: Successful sends mark the day as `alerted=true`, so failed alerts are not retried for the rest of the day, which contradicts the README's retry statement. This is the same root cause as the 195-201 entry, but the line range does not overlap, so it is kept separate. Rated MAJOR, mapped to high.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:147-148 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: If the `jq` extraction of the evaluator's counts fails, or `${result}` is empty, `counts="$(... jq ...)" || counts=""` plus `read ... <<< "${counts:-0 0 0 0}"` silently sets every counter to 0.
  WHY: The run logs `STAGE_SWITCH_WATCH outcome=ok off=0 ... alert=none` and "No stage switch is off." with no `::warning::`, which can hide switches that should have raised an alert. Every other failure path in the wrapper emits a warning. All three reviewers rated it NIT (low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says this path cannot be reached, because the Python evaluate step uses `json.dump`.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:49-51; .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:443, 454, 467 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `stage_switch_enabled()` checks the variable case-insensitively, but the workflow `if:` gates `(vars.STAGE_SWITCH_WATCH_ENABLED || 'true') == 'true'` are said to compare case-sensitively.
  WHY: With the variable set to `TRUE`, the always-run read step (line 430) does the paginated variables listing and logs `outcome=snapshot_ready`, while lookup, report and save are skipped. No report is produced and no `outcome=disabled` line is logged (README.md:176). All three reviewers rated it NIT (low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says the finding is invalid because GitHub Actions expressions compare strings without regard to case.
- agents.d/9994-stage-switch-watch.md:4; README.md:175-176 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `STAGE_SWITCH_OFF` log-prefix bullet and the README `STAGE_SWITCH_WATCH_ENABLED` row still say the watch reports switches "whose value is not `true`". The last run added per-switch `on_values` (`1`/`yes`/`on`) in `_value_class` (stage_switch_watch.py lines 79-82) and set them on 9 registry entries.
  WHY: The contract under "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" is now wrong. For example, `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED=yes` emits no `STAGE_SWITCH_OFF` line, although the contract promises one. Only the documentation is wrong; the code is consistent. All reviewers rated it NIT (low).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:stage_switch_report `if [ "${delivered}" -gt 0 ]; then mkdir -p "${stage_switch_alert_marker_dir}" ... date -u +%F > ".../day.txt" ...; echo "alerted=true" >> "${stage_switch_output}"` block (saved by the workflow step "Record today's stage switch alert") | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Moving the gate from `attempted > 0` to `delivered > 0` fixes the case where every send fails, but not a partial failure. If one of three sends succeeds, day.txt and `alerted=true` are still written, and the cache key `stage-switch-off-alert-<day>` is saved.
  WHY: Later runs that day get `cache-hit == 'true'` and log `alert=already_sent_today`, so the failed alerts wait until the next day. The README "Alert" bullet and the script header promise more than the code does. Smallest fix: reword them. Gating on `delivered -eq attempted` would resend alerts that were already delivered.
- agents.d/9994-stage-switch-watch.md:line 4 (`STAGE_SWITCH_OFF` bullet); README.md `STAGE_SWITCH_WATCH_ENABLED` row in "#### Variables" | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "whose value is not `true`" was not updated after the per-switch `on_values` were added (9 registry entries, including ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED and E2E_ALT_MODEL_ENABLED).
  WHY: The log-prefix contract is now wrong. For example, `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED=yes` emits no `STAGE_SWITCH_OFF` line. Only the documentation is wrong.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): reword the retry promise in the script header and the README Alert bullet; replace "whose value is not `true`" with "whose value is neither `true` nor one of the entry's `on_values`". HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Pass-1 findings verified and dropped (3 related items): the case-mismatch finding (scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:49-51) is invalid because Actions expressions compare strings without regard to case; the jq counts fallback (lines 147-148) cannot be reached because of `json.dump`; the `on_values` entries were checked against their consumers and are correct.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:`if [ "${delivered}" -gt 0 ]; then` block in `stage_switch_report` (.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml ~467-473) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The day marker and `alerted=true` are written when any alert is delivered, not only when every attempted alert is delivered.
  WHY: After a partial failure, the next run hits the cache and logs `alert=already_sent_today`, so the failed alerts are not retried until the next 06:00 UTC run. The README and the header comment are accurate only when every send fails. No `::warning::` is emitted.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:49-51; .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:443, 454, 467 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The wrapper's enable check is case-insensitive, but the workflow `if:` checks are case-sensitive `== 'true'`.
  WHY: With "TRUE", the read step (`if: ${{ always() }}`) runs the paginated listing and logs `outcome=snapshot_ready`, while lookup, report and save are skipped. `outcome=disabled` (README.md:176) is never logged, and the API listing is wasted every day.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:`counts="$(... jq -r ... 2>/dev/null)" || counts=""` / `read -r off_count waiting_count on_purpose_count alert_count <<< "${counts:-0 0 0 0}"` in `stage_switch_report` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed `jq` extraction, or an empty `${result}`, silently sets every counter to zero.
  WHY: The run logs `outcome=ok off=0 ... alert=none` and "No stage switch is off." with no `::warning::`, unlike the wrapper's other failure paths.
- README.md:175; agents.d/9994-stage-switch-watch.md:4 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The public description was not updated when the per-switch `on_values` allowlist (`1`, `yes`, `on`) was added.
  WHY: Documentation and contract drift only. The 9 switches (ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED, E2E_ALT_MODEL_ENABLED, HEAL_INTAKE_QUEUE_ENABLED, PROVIDER_OUTAGE_RESUME_ENABLED, RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED, REVIEW_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_CAP_ENABLED, WORKFLOW_HEAL_PR_RECONCILE_ENABLED, CHATGPT_POOL_HEALTH_ALERT_ENABLED, E2E_PHASE4B_QUEUED_GRACE_ENABLED) emit no `STAGE_SWITCH_OFF` line for these values.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:195-201 (gate `if [ "${delivered}" -gt 0 ]`) with workflow-log-analysis.yml:467-473 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The day marker and `alerted=true` are written when at least one message is delivered, not when all are. The comment at lines 197-198 ("a failed send is retried by a later run that day") no longer holds.
  WHY: Later runs get `cache-hit == 'true'` (workflow-log-analysis.yml:443) and log `alert=already_sent_today` (stage_switch_watch.sh:168-169), so the failed switch's alert is suppressed until the next 06:00 run. This contradicts the script header (lines 17-20) and the README.

  WHY: No report and no `outcome=disabled` line are produced (contradicting README.md:176), one paginated API listing is wasted every day, and triage assumes the watch ran.

  PROBLEM: If the jq extraction fails, every count falls back to 0 with no `::warning::`. The run logs `outcome=ok off=0 ... alert=none`, and the summary says "No stage switch is off." (line 154-155).
  WHY: State that should raise an alert is hidden behind a healthy-looking line. This is the wrapper's only silent failure path.
